title: Watch Service History Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=watch:service
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by reference_number
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when watch service history data has stopped arriving for a given reference.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per reference and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers when one part of your watch service history feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
